reasons.specificity: It accurately distinguishes critical, reflective, and weak-critical readings, natural versus spiritual death, modern parabasis, philosophical mediation, and the formal subjective remainder.
reasons.anchoring: All eleven quoted anchors occur in Elling’s text and support the attributed modalities, scopes, transitions, and conclusions.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully isolates the modal repair—necessary threat versus necessary unfreedom—and locates genuine contradiction in modern subjectivity’s self-description rather than in ethical life itself.
reasons.coherence: The prose, findings ledger, and tables consistently preserve owners, levels, and necessity/contingency distinctions, though repeated scope assessments add redundancy.
reasons.usefulness: The relations, transitions, and remainders are well mapped, but the response substantially violates the requested one-page format and buries the core account under duplicated ledgers and assessments.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Claims remain closely bounded to the article, with only minor extrapolation in the counterfactual claim that the negative argument and modal distinction would survive failure of the proposed remedy.

score.one_line: A highly accurate, source-anchored account of Elling’s weak-critical mediation and remainder, weakened chiefly by severe overlength and repetition relative to the requested one-page artifact.
